name: Service worker has no runtime caching
description: Rebuilds the dashboard when vite.config.ts changes and fails if hub/static/sw.js contains runtime caching (live readouts must never be served from cache).

then.command: npm --prefix dashboard run build && python -c "import re,sys; s=open('hub/static/sw.js',encoding='utf-8').read(); m=re.search(r'runtimeCaching|NetworkFirst|NetworkOnly|StaleWhileRevalidate|CacheFirst|CacheOnly',s); print('runtime caching found: '+m.group(0) if m else 'OK'); sys.exit(1 if m else 0)"
